note: Elemental Leviathans (swarm elemental-drakes). Order of elements = index in the sim state and the snapshot (append only). perKill = team bonus per kill of that element (summed, BonusStat keys of sim/items/inventory.ts); soul = extra bonus when the team reached soulAt kills and the soul element is this one. Rotation: spawn 1 random, spawn 2 random other, spawn 3 = soul (map) element (differs from 1 and 2), then random without repeating the previous one. Once a team has the soul the pit spawns the Uralt-Leviathan (elder) instead; its kill gives the team an execute buff.
